trial_court: Family Court NO.3, Ahmedabad in Family suit NO.894/2019
case_name: Sanjay Bachubhai Sharma vs Pranalinaben W/O Sanjaybhai Sharma
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner is an advocate at the Metro Court and since 2005, he is residing in Canada and doing job. He has obtained divorce through court from his earlier wife and as he was in need of a partner, he had given an advertisement for marriage in newspaper.

legal_principles.principle: The principle of res-judicata applies to prevent multiplicity of proceedings in civil and criminal courts.
legal_principles.held: Had it been the case that the respondent had not preferred Family Suit No.2446 of 2018, then her application under Section 19 read with Section 26 of the Act in petitioner's Family Suit No.894 of 2019 could have been entertained, but in the present case the very same court has rejected the Exh.5 application of the respondent in Family Suit No.2446 of 2018 and the suit itself is dismissed.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005 — Section 19
Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005 — Section 26

legal_principles.principle: To invoke section 19 of the Act, there should be prima facie occurrence of Domestic Violence and the subject matter property should be shared-household.
legal_principles.held: Two basic criteria for invoking section 19 of the Act are (a) There should be prima facie occurrence of Domestic Violence Act and (b) The subject matter property should be shared-household.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005 — Section 19

outcome.final_order: The judgment and order passed by the learned Family Court no.3, Ahmedabad in Family suit NO.894/2019 was set aside.
